fact: Cyber Defense Africa, the Togo government (68%) and Asseco Data Systems (32%) joint venture, had about EUR 7 million of its capital spending funded by a loan from a local private bank, Asseco put in EUR 1 million, and the company had repaid nearly half the loan by 2023.
title: Éradiquer les risques de la numérisation grâce aux co entreprises : le cas du Togo
publisher: Centre pour l'innovation dans la gouvernance internationale (CIGI)
